symptom: Adding a fill to a layer with an authored gradient and image background wrote background-image:none, discarding the existing painted stack.
rule: Fill creation must not clear an existing background-image. Until fills are a true editable stack, only offer Add where the solid colour write cannot replace an authored or visible fill.
check: pnpm exec vitest run apps/desktop/src/renderer/features/design-workspace/__tests__/design-fill-destructive-edits.test.ts -t 'adds a fill on a layer with a gradient and image stack without discarding it'
